verdict.rationale: Fenwick has a dedicated Trademark practice page. It documents registration in over 180 jurisdictions, more than 32,000 applications and registrations under prosecution, and over 3,500 active trademark disputes, which covers registration and enforcement. A custom trademark extranet supports portfolio and dispute docket management. However, trademark clearance (search and availability opinions) is never explicitly documented, so the story is not fully covered. missing for 10: explicit documentation of trademark clearance/search services, independent or hands-on corroboration of the trademark practice's enforcement work.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: Register marks in over 180 jurisdictions worldwide
Handle over 3,500 active domestic and international disputes regarding trademark rights
Easy-to-use tabs offer full searching, reporting and docket management for complete portfolios, individual marks and dispute matters.
